title: Impossible to connect from element, using docker on raspberry pi 4

labels.name: X-Needs-Info
labels.description: This issue is blocked awaiting information from the reporter

body:
hello!!
I am having this problem, are almost 3 days i am trying to make it work, but with no success, i explain my procedure:

1 docker run -it --rm \
    --mount type=volume,src=synapse-data,dst=/data \
    -e SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME=xxxxxxx.dynu.net\
    -e SYNAPSE_REPORT_STATS=yes \
     matrixdotorg/synapse:v1.26.0  generate

i am using the version 1.26.0 because i am using RPI4 with debian 10 ARMHF

2 docker run -d --name synapse \
    --mount type=volume,src=synapse-data,dst=/data \
    -p 8008:8008 \
    -e TZ=Europe/Rome\
  matrixdotorg/synapse

the docker starts and i a able to enter from the bworser with http://.......:8008

but when i want to try to enter from the app Element i am not able end on the router i open the port 8008

i've tried with a lot of different settings on the file homeserver.yaml, but nothing
